name: MatterDraft Studio
title: MatterDraft Studio — Legal document workflows
description: A local-first legal document desktop workspace in development for Windows and macOS. Organise, OCR, collate and review matter documents.
summary: MatterDraft is being developed as a local-first desktop workspace for preparing and organising legal documents, from source files to a reviewed, indexed document bundle.
qualifications: The product is in development. Release timing has not been announced; illustrated features are intended workflows, not evidence of a released production feature.
Website demonstrations use fictional documents and sample data. They do not process or upload a real legal matter.
The website does not offer checkout, process purchases or create customer accounts.
Local-first describes local document workflows. Separately offered sharing or other connected features may require a network connection and their own disclosure.
OCR output is editable recognised text; it is not a promise of generative legal drafting or error-free recognition.
Electronic signature placement is distinct from digital certification. Court acceptance and legal validity require separate review.
Users must review document content, ordering, page ranges, indexes, bookmarks and other outputs before use or filing.

capabilities.title: Import and organise
capabilities.description: Bring PDF, Word and image source material into matter workflows. Organise documents into categories and parts, work across matter tabs, and choose the order of included documents.

capabilities.title: Recognise text and prepare documents
capabilities.description: Intended OCR workflows turn scanned content into editable text for review. Structured templates use supplied fields to prepare documents; the website examples do not generate legal arguments.

capabilities.title: Edit and manage pages
capabilities.description: Intended document tools cover merging, splitting, extracting, replacing, reordering, cropping, rotating, deleting and inserting pages.

capabilities.title: Collate, paginate and index
capabilities.description: Arrange documents within parts and rebuild a coordinated bundle, page numbering and index. Review updated page ranges after a change to the source order.

capabilities.title: Create and edit bookmarks
capabilities.description: Generate bookmarks from the document structure and review them alongside manual bookmark labels, page references and hierarchy.

capabilities.title: Plan document-aware volumes
capabilities.description: Plan volumes around an approximate 300-page target while considering document boundaries. The target is not an absolute limit; an oversized individual document needs separate review.

capabilities.title: Check and export
capabilities.description: Review validation findings before export. Intended output workflows include PDF and other supported document or archive formats; support depends on the relevant feature and release.

capabilities.title: Apply document controls
capabilities.description: Intended tools include password protection, redaction, electronic signature placement, watermarks and timestamps. Users remain responsible for checking the resulting documents and applicable requirements.

legalDocuments.title: Terms and Conditions
